posts.title: Some thoughts on GHC's SIMD primitives
posts.description: The use of parallelization is essential to exploit the performance of modern computers. In particular, we want to take advantage of SIMD, multi-core, and GPUs. This article will focus on SIMD — single instruction, multiple data. GHC has provided primitives for SIMD for years, but they have not been effectively utilized.
